map.IRR 直观看收益率，但非常规现金流可能多解；NPV 直接看绝对增值，规模决策更: IRR shows the return rate directly, but unconventional cash flows may produce multiple solutions; NPV looks at absolute value added and is more reliable for scale decisions.

map.现金流符号多次变号（例如中途追加投资）时可能出现多个 IRR 解；若现金流全为正: When the cash flow sign changes more than once (for example additional investment midway), multiple IRR solutions may appear; if all cash flows are positive or all negative there is no solution at all. For such projects look at NPV directly rather than relying on IRR.
map.内部收益率 IRR（数值解）：IRR 为使 NPV = Σ CF_t ÷ (1+: Internal rate of return IRR (numerical solution): the discount rate r that makes NPV = Σ CF_t ÷ (1+r)^t = 0 (CF₀, the initial investment, is usually negative); solved by bisection — interval [−0.99, 10], 200 iterations, raising the lower bound when NPV(midpoint) > 0 and lowering the upper bound otherwise, then taking the interval midpoint, ×100 displayed (%). Validation: no strict validation; empty values in the five cash flows fall back to 0. Criteria: no fixed grading; the project is viable when IRR exceeds the cost of capital (hurdle rate), and the solution is unique when conventional cash flows change sign only once.
